title: What the assistant can see for customers and administrators
text: Your role is taken from your signed-in account on the server, never from what you type. Customers' chat can use public vehicle listings and that customer's own bookings only. Administrators' chat can also use fleet status counts, maintenance records, verified maintenance evidence and model-based service-need predictions. The assistant never returns other customers' bookings or personal details, passwords, tokens or API keys, and it cannot create, change or delete records.
keywords: what data can the chatbot see

title: Common error messages and what to do
text: 'Authentication is required' (401): your session expired; sign in again. 'Administrator access is required' (403): the page or action is for administrators only. 'This vehicle is already reserved for part or all of those dates' or 'not available for those dates' (409): choose other dates or another vehicle. 'The selected dates do not meet this vehicle's minimum rental duration' (422): extend the period. 'Enter a message of up to 4,000 characters' (422): shorten the chat message. 'The local AI chat service is unavailable right now' (503): the Python AI service is not running or not reachable; an administrator should start it (python manage.py runserver 127.0.0.1:8001) and check AI_SERVICE_API_URL and AI_SERVICE_API_KEY.

title: Managing vehicles (administrators)
text: Administrators manage the inventory at /admin/vehicles: create a vehicle (/admin/vehicles/create), edit its details, daily rate, deposit, minimum rental duration, category and status, upload or delete images, or delete the vehicle. Setting status to maintenance or unavailable prevents new reservations.

title: Maintenance records, 3D inspection and evidence collection (administrators)
text: Maintenance Records (/admin/maintenance/records) logs services with type, date, cost, status and odometer, and updates vehicle mileage. Predictive Maintenance (/admin/maintenance/predictions) opens a 3D view per vehicle where each component shows three separate results: condition from the latest manual inspection, schedule status from configured service intervals, and the model-based service-need prediction (shown as unavailable, with the reason, until a model passes acceptance). Inspections and service intervals are recorded there. Maintenance Data Collection (/admin/maintenance/data) holds evidence records (symptoms, DTCs, confirmed cause, repair outcome) that move from draft to submitted to verified; only verified records are treated as confirmed evidence.

title: What the maintenance prediction means and its limits
text: A maintenance prediction is shown only when a model has passed the service's acceptance gate (group-held-out evaluation, at least the baseline, calibrated probabilities). The candidate is a service-need model: for a vehicle's current odometer, body type and fuel type it estimates the probability that each service item (air filter, brake fluid, transmission fluid and so on) would be performed at a workshop visit. It was trained on 1,139 workshop visits for four car models (Honda Jazz, Amaze, City; Toyota Fortuner) and tested on a car model it had not seen. As of 2026-10-31 no version has passed the gate (best held-out macro F1 0.54 to 0.73 against a 0.60 minimum and the baseline), so predictions are reported as unavailable with that reason. It is a scheduled-service need, not a detected fault or a failure forecast, and never gives failure dates. Always confirm by inspection and the manufacturer schedule.

title: Rule-based service due estimates
text: The maintenance overview also computes rule-based due estimates: a vehicle is approaching when its baseline 180-day interval since the last completed service ends within 30 days, and overdue when 5,000 km have been driven since the last recorded service odometer, a recorded next-maintenance date has passed, or 180 days have passed. Vehicles with no completed service history are marked insufficient. These are schedule estimates, not mechanical assessments; check the manufacturer schedule.

title: Approving and managing reservations (administrators)
text: Administrators review reservations at Reservations (/admin/reservations), with past ones under Reservation History (/admin/reservations/history). A pending reservation can be confirmed, rejected or cancelled; a confirmed one can be cancelled or marked completed. Dates and prices cannot be edited.

title: Changing or resetting a password
text: DriveRent has no password-change or password-reset feature yet: there is no page or API for it, and the sign-in page has no "forgot password" link. If you need a new password or cannot sign in, contact the rental team.
keywords: how do I change my password

title: Pickup and return of a rental
text: Each reservation records a pickup date and a return date; the return date is not counted as a rental day. The system stores no pickup or return times, no pickup location, and no fuel, cleaning or handover rules, so confirm those with the rental team. After the return, an administrator marks the confirmed reservation completed.
